source_note: 函数与序列的上下极限
english_source_note: Limsup and Liminf of Functions and Sequences
callout_id: 函数与序列的上下极限#5
statement_en: For nonnegative bounded sequences $x_n,y_n$, $$\begin{aligned}\limsup_{n\to \infty} x_n\limsup_{n\to \infty} y_n&\geq \limsup_{n\to \infty} x_ny_n\\&\geq \liminf_{n\to \infty}x_ny_n\\ &\geq \liminf_{n\to \infty}x_n\liminf_{n\to \infty}y_n.\end{aligned}$$
key_techniques: order properties of limsup and liminf
callout_body: 对于非负有界序列$x_n,y_n$那么$$\begin{aligned}\limsup_{n\to \infty} x_n\limsup_{n\to \infty} y_n&\geq \limsup_{n\to \infty} x_ny_n\\&\geq \liminf_{n\to \infty}x_ny_n\\ &\geq \liminf_{n\to \infty}x_n\liminf_{n\to \infty}y_n\end{aligned}$$
